summary.title: BAKKA BORETTSLAG

narrative.text: BAKKA BORETTSLAG is a Norwegian housing cooperative in "Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier", registered 1995-02-19.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 2.6 million and an annual result of NOK -154,541.
Head office in Odda, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
